overview: 2026年，Solarvest 通过认购 Hartanah Kenyalang Berhad 6.60% 新股成为其主要股东，并与 Vista Contracting and Investment Global Pte. Ltd. 及 FBG Land Sdn. Bhd. 的谅解备忘录持续讨论中。公司未公告新的业务板块扩张、缩减或退出。
overview_en: In 2026, Solarvest became a substantial shareholder of Hartanah Kenyalang Berhad with a 6.60% stake via a private placement subscription, while its MOUs with Vista Contracting and Investment Global Pte. Ltd. and FBG Land Sdn. Bhd. remain under discussion. No new business segment expansion, reduction or exit was announced.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司层面进行股权投资及持续更新谅解备忘录状态。
segments.note_en: At the company level, it made an equity investment and continued to update the status of its MOUs.

actions.text_en: Updated the status of the MOUs with Vista Contracting and Investment Global Pte. Ltd. and FBG Land Sdn. Bhd.; both parties are still in discussion on potential strategic cooperation.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以现金 RM12,375,000 认购 Hartanah Kenyalang Berhad 45,000,000 股新股，占扩大后已发行股本 6.60%，成为其主要股东。
actions.text_en: Subscribed to 45,000,000 new ordinary shares in Hartanah Kenyalang Berhad for a total cash consideration of RM12,375,000, representing 6.60% of the enlarged issued share capital, becoming a substantial shareholder.
